body:
Public data receiving milestone following the approved private H4 experiment:

`from peptidemt import HydrAMPReceipt` now exposes the already-tested receipt as a provisional public **data** API. `from_trace` receives an already produced owner trace; `to_json/from_json`, `issues` and `inputs` preserve the existing v1 meanings. This does not load/run HydrAMP or Macrel, infer chemistry or turn native AMP/MIC evidence into Macrel columns. The old private import path remains available.

JSON integrity fix: the private receipt reader previously used ordinary json.loads and accepted duplicate keys, potentially overwriting a seed, nested sequence, score tag or provenance field. Both receipt and ResultSet now reuse the existing ResultSet duplicate-key rejection through one private data-layer helper. Four nested/envelope regressions protect that mechanism. Valid old payloads, scores, occurrence mappings and selectors are unchanged.

Exact local unpublished wheel:
`peptidemt-0.1.0+118.g1f8c444.dirty-py3-none-any.whl`
SHA-256 `1f5eed48b1d94d6d0d97b85d40400a958d693623717f17d9265147f1abb8919e`.

It is installed only in a new task-owned venv inheriting the unchanged frozen W3 dependencies. All 22 wheel members except RECORD match installed bytes; all 18 Python files match both wheel and current source; actual import origin is the new installed package. pip check passes. **41 installed checks pass** (21 receipt, 18 source-controller/transport, 2 W1 compatibility), with published Pytest Receptor 1.1.0 and native JUnit agreement. Source testing also covers 41 distinct cases; its first 40-pass/1-failure run and the successful single-case import-harness correction are retained.

The installed public reader replays the original two H4 generation receipts and three assessment files exactly: 32 proposals, 34 eligible rows including controls, both complete rankings/selections. Scientific providers, artifacts and network are blocked. This is saved-data verification, not another scientific run.

The user guide/API reference now document use and limits. Sphinx HTML builds with no warnings and six unchanged memory-input doctests pass against the exact installed consumer package. Ruff lint/format, navigation, whitespace and 225 relative file links pass. Previous consumer source bytes are archived, including old H4 receiver SHA `befeab875836a1d71277642fb541c95c13dab80fcff166eefc76f7c02ed98f04`; historical receipts are not relabelled as tests of this candidate.

Maintained local records: `devguide/hydramp_public_receiving.md`, `docs/content/user/generation_results.md`.
Execution evidence: `devguide/evidence/hydramp_public_receiving.json`,
SHA-256 `1c12fd16edca2ba297de7d154c5e93ea08ad0311849157018463d5ffa7e52ad0`.

**Zero new model/PCA/descriptor/Macrel calls.** Old allowances remain exhausted. Public generation execution/attribution integration, broader dev3 scientific disposition and other platform/minor qualification remain pending. The previous joint AMP/hemolysis limitation remains unchanged. No new runtime dependency/extra, molecular parser, descriptor formula, selector, commit, push, hosted site or public package release. Retain resources through 2026-11-13.
scope: Consumer data API only; no new scientific execution, adoption or publication allowance
